audit_scope: Bounded read-only repository search and implementation review; not an exhaustive novelty claim. Existing report numbers quoted, no quality arrays or new metrics computed.
exact_method_sought: Frozen operational R0 GEO as anchor; source candidate admissible iff exact T<=anchorT AND R<=anchorR; fixed TRAIN minmax target among those candidates; learn scores over all original geometrically valid candidates.

prior_methods.name: Current physical-pose minmax classifiers
prior_methods.difference: All geometrically valid candidates compete; whole-pose fixed minmax target. Pareto only handles exact-cost ties. No R0-anchored two-axis admissibility mask.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: Converged CE source VAL failed4/45; pairwise source VAL failed16/45. Neither authorized learned real routing.

prior_methods.name: N2/Replay learned utility
prior_methods.difference: Pointwise normalized 2D signed-gain SmoothL1; accept a vertical pair when both predicted endpoint gains are positive. Neither whole-pose T/R labels nor a Pareto admissibility target.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: Source clean PCK10 95.233% to93.618%; GREEN PCK10 81.351% to78.267%. Accepted a recorded4.34 to168.30px harmful correction.

prior_methods.name: Geometry/confidence pair rollback
prior_methods.difference: GT-free hand thresholds on confidence, removal stability, flip agreement and heatmap spread; reconstruct paired coordinates and revert failed structure checks. No learned physicalT/R target.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: GREEN81.351% to79.736%; DEV59.459% to58.919% for the full pair gate.

prior_methods.name: DHT local one-sided no-harm
prior_methods.difference: Continuous point correction loss plus normalized ReLU(new2Derror-base2Derror) and utility. No fixed-candidate anchored physicalT/R eligibility.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: All three Hough seeds failed primary1% gain and worsened median/P90; track closed without real evaluation.

prior_methods.name: Whole-layout relative-gain regression
prior_methods.difference: SmoothL1 signed mean2Dgain for choosing complete P/Q layouts; calibration used aggregate median/P90 and damage guards. Not per-candidate physicalT/R Pareto-safe targets.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: Three seeds population mean gain +0.016280/0/-0.019861px; synthetic gate FAIL.

prior_methods.name: Stage4 expert routing
prior_methods.difference: Choose smaller C2 ADDnorm between two experts after their W/D decision, then unweighted BCE. No physical T and R nonincrease conjunction.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: Synthetic TEST ADDnorm routed0.09768815 worse than S0 0.09621724 despite oracle0.09031495; real verdict CLEAN_RECOVERY_BUT_HARD_LOSS.

prior_methods.name: Displacement cap
prior_methods.difference: Cap2D displacement to1%image diagonal. No trained selector or physical error guarantee; uncapped output remains primary.
prior_methods.existing_negative_evidence: At640x480 cap8px cannot recover same-correspondence >20px errors to<=10px. Capped results explicitly cannot replace failed primary.

preserved_data.eligibility: Pre-existing declared C2 and proper-rigid metadata; no outcome-based frame deletion. C1/improper rows remain diagnostic.
preserved_data.refiner_overlap_count_scope: Original selector TRAIN4096/VAL1024/TEST1024; not newly recomputed for eligible TRAIN2598.
preserved_data.VAL_status: Repeated development population, one renderer group; not pristine frozen-refiner holdout.
preserved_data.runtime_inputs: One RGB image, pallet dimensions, existing calibrated K. No temporal trajectory or new sensor.

minimal_intervention.change: Only source target admissibility relative to operational R0, retaining existing minmax scales, tie order, candidate94 features, CE+explicitL2, normalization, solver and evaluation gates.
minimal_intervention.must_preserve_competitors: Do not remove unsafe candidates from CE denominators or runtime validity; safe mask defines source targets only.
minimal_intervention.no_runtime_safety_guarantee: GT-derived target safety does not imply the learned model can recognize safe candidates on VAL or real frames.
minimal_intervention.R0_control: If anchored targets are applied to R0_ONLY, train a new control; old weight cannot be claimed to optimize identical targets.
minimal_intervention.prerequisites: Root seals diagnostic protocol, independently verifies real anchored feasibility, then seals SOURCE_PROTOCOL before any actual TRAIN target calculation. PASS permits only separately sealed fitting.
